title: The Discrete Algebra of the Fourier Transform
byline: Gabriel Peyré · English translation of “L’algèbre discrète de la transformée de Fourier”
note: Exercise solutions and the Matlab/Maple listings at the end (PDF pp. 221–296) are not broken down. Summaries are in our own words; the text stays in the PDF.
summary: An algebraic treatment of Fourier analysis in the finite setting. Peyré starts from duality on finite groups (characters, the dual group, Fourier transform and Plancherel), applies it to Gauss sums, the Walsh transform and Poisson summation, and then develops the discrete Fourier transform for signal processing: the FFT, circular convolution, multidimensional transforms, filtering, solving differential equations and fast multiplication. Later chapters extend the idea to the Hartley, Z and fractional Fourier transforms, to transforms over finite fields and rings with error-correcting codes, and finally to linear representations of finite non-abelian groups, characters and their applications.
